title: Tech in the 417: Findings from the Regional Workplace Survey

description: Tech in the 417: Findings from the Regional Workplace Survey takes place on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 5:30 PM. It will be held at The eFactory (Robert W Plaster Free Enterprise Center), 405 N Jefferson Ave, in Springfield, MO. The event is hosted by Springfield Women In Technology and is aimed at a business audience.
